subject: english
title: Let’s Talk 7–9 — Showing Interest & Asking for Help
subtitle: Checkpoint after Units 7–9 · v1 · 17 slides · SB pp.166–167 · TR 9.12–9.14 · the two jobs of the page → Activity 1 dialogue → the echo question (Do you? / Are you? / Did you?) → reacting → act it out twice → Activity 3 dialogue → the three questions about a word → not sure vs. disagreeing → Why don’t you…? → Activity 4’s two discussions → the house rule → Formative Assessment

content: Show interest in what someone says with a short echo question.
React to good news instead of closing the conversation down.
Ask about an unknown word three different ways, in English.
Say you are not sure, disagree politely, and suggest what to do next.
language: Use the echo question with the right auxiliary: Do you? / Are you? / Does he? / Did they? / Can she? / Will you?
Use Wow. That’s so cool! and What about you?
Use What does ___ mean? · How do you spell ___? · How do you say ___ in English?
Use I’m not sure. · No idea. · Um, I don’t think so. · Why don’t you/we ask the teacher? · That’s a good idea.
